earliest_visible_sign.description: The very first visible change, before typical lesions/signs develop
earliest_visible_sign.shape: e.g. minute fleck, circular spot, longitudinal stripe
earliest_visible_sign.location_on_plant: e.g. lower leaves, newly emerging whorl leaves, youngest leaves

characteristic_sign_or_lesion.description: The key diagnostic visual feature unique to this disease or pest. Be as specific as possible.

colors.color_progression: How color changes from early to mature stage, e.g. pale green to grey-green to tan/straw

shape.primary_shape: SELECT ONE OR MORE: circular | oval | elliptical | spindle | cigar_shaped | rectangular | diamond | irregular | pustule | gall | streak | stripe | blotch | window_pane | shot_hole
shape_descriptors: Additional shape keywords e.g. tapered at both ends, vein-limited, powdery raised blister
shape.shape_progression: How shape evolves, e.g. oval early to cigar-shaped mature to irregular after coalescence

size.diameter_mm: For circular/oval lesions — e.g. 1-4 mm or null
size.size_variation_note: Key factors affecting size, e.g. varies with cultivar, infection timing, and humidity

texture_and_surface.surface: e.g. flat, raised, powdery, dusty, smooth membrane-covered, rough/wrinkled
texture_and_surface.sporulation_or_sign: e.g. dark grey sooty sporulation on lesion underside in humid conditions or null
texture_and_surface.other_surface_details: e.g. ruptured membrane releases black powder, epidermis ruptures to release spores

border_and_margin.margin_type: e.g. diffuse, sharply defined, vein-limited, dark margin
border_and_margin.halo: e.g. narrow yellow chlorotic halo or null

advanced_or_severe_stage.description: Appearance when infection is heavy or late-stage
advanced_or_severe_stage.coalescence: How lesions merge, e.g. individual lesions merge into large brown necrotic areas
advanced_or_severe_stage.tissue_death_appearance: e.g. leaves dry, brittle, tan-brown; severe blighting resembles frost damage
advanced_or_severe_stage.percentage_affected_tissue_note: Qualitative description of tissue loss in severe cases

distribution_on_plant.vertical_pattern: e.g. starts on lower leaves and progresses upward or whorl-first
distribution_on_plant.horizontal_pattern: e.g. scattered over entire leaf surface, concentrated near leaf margins and veins
distribution_on_plant.other_parts_if_severe: e.g. may extend to husks, tassels, stalks in severe infections

pathognomonic_features: The one or two visual features most uniquely diagnostic for this disease.
e.g. long cigar-shaped lesion 3-15 cm tapered at both ends with olive-grey sporulation on underside
